statement: The complete declared fixed-packet structure lifts across the capacity-indexed generation-register family from one source rule. Under the source-closed continuation reading every admissible completion saturates every rung and the slack zero set is all rungs; under the widened reading the surviving completions carry inequivalent zero sets. In both readings the complete declared source class does not entail a unique slack zero, so the direct capacity selector requires an additional source law.
